mentions.name: no-exceptions
mentions.description: This is a TypeScript npm package, "no-exceptions", that provides an alternative to the "neverthrow" library for error handling, built because the author found neverthrow's API not very ergonomic.
mentions.problem: The neverthrow TypeScript package's API is not very ergonomic for error handling.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I built an alternative to the Typescript package "neverthrow" called "no-exceptions"

I found neverthrow's api to be not very ergonomic so I built my own little version.
